about.en: Coupang, Inc. is a US-incorporated e-commerce company that runs South Korea's largest online retail marketplace, with its own logistics and Rocket delivery network, plus food delivery (Coupang Eats), streaming (Coupang Play) and the Farfetch luxury platform. CPNG represents its Class A common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange; some venues mislabel it "CouponGroup".
